_meta.notes: Living results artifact. Updated as cells complete. The presentation.md narrative wraps story/insights around these numbers.

Qwen/Qwen3-32B (max_tokens=1024 BROKEN).note: TRUNCATED — thinking mode + 1024 cap. NOT a fair number.

Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B.note: in flight; subagent run, vllm 0.20.2 + transformers 5.8.0 + FLASH_ATTN backend

linking.description: LLM linker pass selects relevant tables/columns from a compact schema; downstream SQL gen uses filtered DDL. Lexical pass + ensure_keys closure on FKs.
bug_fixes: FK with NULL to_column from PRAGMA — handle gracefully (commit 6c92e33)

restrict_schema → _column_def emitted column names without backticks; multi-word BIRD names became invalid DDL → exec_errors. Backtick-quote always (commit fe54b5e). Cost ~1.4pp on Qwen3-Coder-MoE, ~1.4pp on Qwen2.5-Coder.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: biggest regression in matrix; exec_error 18 -> 81. Most confident base, most disrupted by filtered DDL.

voting.description: n=8 candidates per question at T=0.6. Execute each, group by canonical result-set hash (SHA-1 of sorted-repr rows), return the SQL whose result has the most votes among executable candidates.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (T=1.0).note: DIAGNOSTIC: bumped to T=1.0 to test MoE-expert-diversity hypothesis. RESULT: WORSE than T=0.6 (+0.13 vs +0.45). Voting on this base is bounded by model capability, not sampling diversity. R1 hypothesis falsified.

Qwen3-32B (thinking).note: INFEASIBLE: timed out twice — v1 at 60min Modal cap, v2 at 120min cap (78% complete). n=8 thinking-mode voting × 1534 questions exceeds Modal's per-function 2h limit. Stacked design (which only votes on failing tail) is the practical alternative.

correction.description: First pass greedy. For exec_error cases, retry with the SQLite error message in the prompt at T=0.2. Cap at 1 retry.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: correction floor — Qwen3.6 has so few exec_errors (~18-21) that rescuing them just hits baseline; no semantic-wrong gains possible from this strategy

cot.description: Two-stage. Stage 1: NL plan at T=0.3 (max_tokens=384). Stage 2: SQL conditioned on the plan at T=0.0 (max_tokens=1024 default; 8192 for thinking).
cot.regression_root_cause: commitment bias — NL plan locks model into wrong column / value choices that free-form SQL would have re-thought. e.g., NCESDist instead of NCESSchool; 'Directly Funded' instead of 'Directly funded'; County instead of City.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: Regressed less than predicted (-1.5 to -2.5pp); thinking + plan stage doubly redundant on a thinking model.

fewshot.description: k=4 examples retrieved from BIRD train via Jaccard on tokenized question text. Same-db_id preferred; cross-db fallback. BIRD train and dev have disjoint db_ids by design — shots are stylistic / pattern-only, never schema-cheating.
fewshot.regression_root_cause_on_strong_coder: anchor bias — shots' patterns (e.g., * 100 ratios, AVG aggregations, JOIN style) get copied into the current question even when inappropriate.

Qwen3-32B (thinking).note: biggest single-strategy lift on Qwen3-32B; non-coder thinking model has SQL-pattern gap that shots fill

Qwen3.6-27B.note: PREDICTION WRONG. Predicted +1-2.5pp based on Q3-32B-thinking +3.07pp pattern; actual is -0.39pp. Fewshot's value diminishes faster than expected as base strength grows.

agentic_routed.description: Route only LOW-CONFIDENCE questions to the agentic loop; keep greedy for everyone else. Routing rules (union): (1) greedy exec_error/timeout, (2) greedy result degenerate (empty / all-NULL / single zero-or-NULL row, executed against the DB), (3) modal-result vote-share <5/8 among 8 voters at T=0.6. Agent: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct or Qwen3.6-27B, 2-tool loop (execute_sql + submit), max_turns=6.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct.note: Largest single-strategy delta on Q3-Coder-MoE (+2.02pp >> correction's +0.91pp). Routing pre-filter is load-bearing: baseline EX on routed slice is 5.35%, so the agent only needs marginal lift to net-positive — and delivers +16.6pp on that slice.

rule_breakdown.low_vote_share_skipped: chunked-prefill issue made full voting infeasible at max_num_batched_tokens=2096

Qwen3.6-27B.note: NEW OVERALL BEST. +2.28pp over Q3.6 greedy, +1.89pp over Q3.6 stacked (prior best 63.69%). Image fix: vllm 0.20.2 + VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0 + attention_backend=FLASH_ATTN + max_num_batched_tokens=2096 (GDN cache alignment). Only 1 break vs 36 fixes — much cleaner contingency than Q3-Coder (1 break vs 7). Q3.6 is more agent-fix-robust than Q3-Coder. Run on rules 1+2 only; full voting (rule 3) skipped due to chunked-prefill — could push higher. Tag: agentic-routed-q36-dev-v1.merged.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct.note: NULL RESULT. keep_baseline_sql cuts per-question break rate 70%→37% as designed, but the agent overuses it (36% of calls) and total fixes collapse 38→13. T=0.7 disagreement rule is the largest regression (low precision on a confident coder). Lesson: bold-and-selective beats cautious-and-broad.

NULL RESULT vs v1. Adds describe_column(table, column) tool returning distinct values + NULL counts + cardinality. Agent used it on 68% of routed questions. Case studies show real wins (q77 disambiguated 'GSserved' enum) but trades ~1-for-1 with v1's no-tool exploration. +0.26pp over v1 but CI straddles zero. v1 stays as the headline.

rl.description: GRPO RL of Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on BIRD train. LoRA r=32/alpha=64 on q/k/v/o, num_generations=4, lr=1e-5, max_steps=100, per_device_bs=1, grad_accum=8 → 32 rollouts/step. Reward = binary execution accuracy with per-question gold-row cache. Total 800 examples seen, 100 steps in 554s on single B200.

Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct (GRPO 100 step.note: Demonstration-scale result. +0.39pp over baseline 47.85%. McNemar p=0.058 — borderline. Reward signal worked (56.9% positive rate over 800 training rollouts). To exceed +2pp likely needs more steps (Arctic-R1 used 6000) and/or larger num_generations and/or full-FT instead of LoRA.

sft_32b_base.description: Full-fine-tuning SFT of Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Base on BIRD train (~5,776 examples after length filter). 8x B200 FSDP via accelerate FullyShardedDataParallelPlugin. Recipe: 1 epoch, peak LR 5e-6 with cosine to 5e-7, 100-step linear warmup, AdamW (betas 0.9, 0.95, wd 0.01), micro_batch=1, grad_accum=4, world=8 → effective_batch=32, max_seq=8192, bf16 throughout, EOS-preserve truncation. Prompt: flat preamble + format_profile schema block (distinct-value lists + FK section) + question + hint + ### SQL. Completion: raw SQL + EOS, no fences.

v2_chat_wrapped_fenced_simple_schema.note: Initial attempt with messages_to_raw_text chat wrapping (SYSTEM:/USER:/ASSISTANT:) + fenced SQL completion + render_ddl_with_samples (DDL + 3 sample rows, no distinct values). 16.6% exec_error tail dominated by a stray ')' artifact — model overfit to BIRD-train's nested CAST/MAX patterns.

v3_flat_simple_schema.note: Dropped chat wrapping for flat preamble + raw SQL completion. Format alignment didn't fix it — exec_error tail unchanged. Ruled out prompt-wrapping as the cause.

v4_flat_rich_schema.note: +22.13pp over raw Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Base (35.38% → 57.51%). exec_error tail collapses from 17%→0.85%. Distinct-value lists in the schema block are the load-bearing addition — model learns valid filter vocabularies instead of guessing from 3 sample rows.

v4_flat_rich_schema_plus_vote_n5.note: Same SFT'd model, n=5 voting at T=0.6 → +1.69pp over greedy. Voting compounds cleanly with SFT.

stacked_voting_correction.description: Composed strategy: greedy correction first; only escalate to voting+correction if greedy errored OR returned degenerate result. Inside voting: greedy is candidate-0 (R2: strict-override only), rescued candidates can't outvote originally-valid ones (R3).

Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct.note: STACKING GAIN: +0.52pp over either voting alone OR correction alone (+0.78). Older-gen base has more diversity-at-T=0.7 → voting finds 13 legitimate corrections greedy missed.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct.note: Worked as engineered; 6.6% escalation; vote rarely overrides greedy. Below correction-alone (+0.91pp). Voting itself has near-zero marginal value on this confident base.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: FIRST scaffolding strategy to beat the Qwen3.6 baseline (only positive delta vs 63.30%). Lower escalation rate than Q3-Coder-MoE but higher vote-override rate — when Q3.6 escalates, voting more often finds a better answer.

Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct.note: RL technique demo on smallest base; +0.39pp at borderline significance

Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Base (SFT).note: +22.13pp over raw Base; matches the Instruct variant of the same model from a pure-SFT-on-Base

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct.note: +2.02pp via probe-then-fix on the 12% lowest-confidence slice. p=7.7e-6.

Qwen3.6-27B.note: NEW OVERALL BEST. +2.28pp over Q3.6 greedy, +1.89pp over Q3.6 stacked (prior best 63.69%). McNemar p=5.5e-10, 36 fixes / 1 break on the 110-routed slice. Cheaper variant of v1 routing (rules 1+2 only, voting skipped due to chunked-prefill).

key_insights: Generation gap dominates at 32B-class: Qwen3 → Qwen2.5 closes ~3.3pp on the same coder-instruct base.
For SQL, coder post-training > thinking-mode + general post-training. Qwen3-Coder-MoE (no thinking) beats Qwen3-32B-thinking-general by ~9pp.
Stronger / newer models concentrate failures away from exec_error: 150 → 38 → 25 → 23.
CoT regresses on every coder base (-1.6 to -2.4pp) due to commitment bias.
Repair strategies (correction, voting) are universally positive but small (+0.4 to +0.9pp). Bounded by exec_error count.
Modify-the-prompt strategies (linking, fewshot) are base-dependent: help weaker / non-coder bases, hurt strong coder bases.
Schema linking with 97.8% recall STILL regressed on Qwen3-Coder-MoE (-1.37pp) because the filtered DDL tilts the model toward worse column choices even when all gold columns are kept.

Agentic routing on a strong coder base outperforms every prior scaffolding by routing only the 12% lowest-confidence questions to a 2-tool agent (execute_sql + submit). Concentrates the +6pp 50-q lift to +2.02pp full-dev with p<1e-5. New overall best on Q3.6 at 65.58% (+2.28pp, p<1e-9).

SFT (Full-FT) on the Qwen2.5-Coder-32B Base substrate lifts +22.13pp over raw greedy, reaching the Instruct variant's level. Schema content (distinct-value lists for low-cardinality columns + explicit FK section) is load-bearing — without it the model hits a 17% exec_error stray-paren artifact ceiling at 48-49%.
RL via GRPO + LoRA on a 7B base produces +0.39pp at 100 steps — demonstrates the technique fires cleanly but lift is marginal at this scale.
Three controlled agentic ablations (v2 = +keep_baseline + expanded routing, v3 = +describe_column) both produced null results vs v1. Lesson: bold-and-selective beats cautious-and-broad.
